title: Name every wagon URN wagon:{kebab-case-name}, built via URNBuilder.wagon

facts.note: Task text mentions creating, renaming or constructing a wagon URN; applies regardless of actor.

values: any file declaring a wagon URN
facts.note: Not limited to a file type: any file where a wagon URN is assigned or constructed is in scope.

values: wagon URN constructed/assigned in code or generator
facts.note: Requires a diff-level observer extracting added/changed `wagon:` URN values and new wagon URN construction sites (string literals vs URNBuilder.wagon calls).

fires: A new wagon manifest is authored and its URN assigned
An existing wagon is renamed and its URN changes
A plan/spec declares a new wagon URN
Implementation or generation code assigns or constructs a new wagon URN
doesNotFire: Editing a wagon's WMBTs or acceptances without touching its URN
Naming a feature, train or artifact URN (governed by their own naming conventions)
Code or docs that only reference an existing, unchanged wagon URN

given: A wagon URN is being assigned or constructed — in a plan, manifest, spec, implementation or generation code, by any author.
when: You create, rename or build the wagon's URN.
then: Build the URN via URNBuilder.wagon so it is wagon:{kebab-case-name}, matching ^wagon:[a-z][a-z0-9-]*$.
prefer: A verb-object slug that names what the wagon does (e.g. resolve-dilemmas, commit-state).
Valid forms as in the source: wagon:resolve-dilemmas, wagon:burn-timebank, wagon:manage-users.
avoid: Hand-assembling the wagon URN string instead of using URNBuilder.wagon.
Uppercase, underscores, spaces, dots or a leading digit/hyphen in the name part.
Noun-only or vague slugs when a verb-object slug fits.
why: Feature URNs, trains and slug/dirname conversion all derive from the wagon URN, so a single predictable kebab grammar built through one builder keeps references and generated paths consistent.
evidence: Wagon URNs constructed in code or generated artifacts are produced via URNBuilder.wagon, not hand-assembled strings.
verifier_detail: Term wagon_urn_pattern ('the wagon URN grammar'): pattern ^wagon:[a-z][a-z0-9-]*$ is the hard check.
Term wagon_urn_pattern preference: verb-object (resolve-dilemmas, commit-state) — a preference, not a hard failure.
Construction check: wagon URNs in code must come from URNBuilder.wagon (statement: 'built via URNBuilder.wagon'); a hand-built 'wagon:' string literal at a construction site is a finding.
